cells.scene: A bright spacious room with a few small pieces of furniture far apart and ample open floor area.
A pale tired passenger sits on a ship's deck holding a small paper bag near their lap, queasy expression, sea horizon behind.
A stern adult looms over a seated smaller adult and points aggressively while the seated person recoils; intimidation without physical violence.
A traveler struggles to carry several heavy suitcases up stairs while another uses a light wheeled bag, practical drawback apparent.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — spacious (a.宽敞的): A bright spacious room with a few small pieces of furniture far apart and ample open floor area.
TOP RIGHT — seasick (a.晕船的): A pale tired passenger sits on a ship's deck holding a small paper bag near their lap, queasy expression, sea horizon behind.
BOTTOM LEFT — intimidate (v.恐吓，恫吓): A stern adult looms over a seated smaller adult and points aggressively while the seated person recoils; intimidation without physical violence.
BOTTOM RIGHT — disadvantage (n.短处，缺点): A traveler struggles to carry several heavy suitcases up stairs while another uses a light wheeled bag, practical drawback apparent.
CRITICAL SAFE COMPOSITION: Make subjects SMALLER than the style reference. Every subject fits within central 65% of its own quadrant, with large 20% white margins on all sides. Bottom-row subjects including heads and thought bubbles begin BELOW 58% of entire canvas height; top subjects end ABOVE 42%. Keep central horizontal 42–58% totally blank white. No head, limb, object or speech bubble crosses either exact 50% midline.
review_notes: Four cells visually checked: wide spacious room; queasy traveler with paper bag on ship; intimidating aggressor and frightened seated listener; burdensome luggage compared with easy traveler. Clear senses, natural anatomy and safe cell separation.
